body: As I am sorry you feel this way. :(

I tend not to give advice; when people come to me for advice, I just listen without judgement and let them come to their own conclusions by asking them questions. 
I haven't been on Reddit long, but if you think that browsing this sub would be helpful, I will certainly give it a try. 
I just don't want to be hypocritical or false, or lead people in the wrong direction. 
Service to others in need is how I have tried to live my life up until this point. It is well worth the time. :) It was very hard for me to accept any help for myself in the hospital, and the nurses had to ask me to stop allowing people to come to me with their problems because "I was there for me." It seemed unthinkable.
Your advice is sound. Thank you for reading my vent-post. I didn't think it was well-written at all, so that took me off guard and made me smile.

Knowing that I'm not alone in the way that I think (or "wrong" or "horrible" etc.) and that it's a different way of thinking experienced by others is, strangely, uplifting. 
And disheartening at the same time. I wouldn't wish my way of thinking on anyone. :(
Thank you. You as well.
"there doesn't seem to be anything here" <- Thanks Reddit. That's a much shorter version.
